items.title: Bill Crow interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: I remember us standing together listening to Joe Williams. And I think it was the first time I’d heard him.

ctx.x: Marshall was the section leader, right. And Charlie Fowlkes was the baritone player. And Freddie Green of course was in. And I can’t remember now whether it was that time or the next time that he came in that Joe Williams was with him. It seems to me that he didn’t have a singer that first time when we were opposite them. Because it seems to me I seem to remember my wife being there — she wasn’t my wife at that time — but a girl I’d started to go with was the camera girl at Birdland. And at that time I was at the…
What was it about that rhythm section that made it so identifiable?
